title: Caltech-256 samples
caption: Sixteen images drawn at random (seed 0) from the frozen test split, after the deterministic evaluation transform Resize(256)+CenterCrop(224).

title: Class imbalance
caption: Per-class test-set counts, ranked. The tail is why macro-F1 and worst-decile class accuracy are reported alongside top-1.

title: Training augmentation
caption: RandomResizedCrop(224, scale 0.5-1.0) + horizontal flip + light colour jitter (0.2/0.2/0.2, hue 0). Deliberately modest: mixup/cutmix/RandAugment are excluded as confounds. De-normalised for display.

title: Corruption severities
caption: Three corruption families at five ImageNet-C severities. Applied to the 224x224 crop in [0,1] before normalisation, seeded per (image, severity) so both architectures score on byte-identical inputs. Never written to disk.

title: Ideal lowpass sweep
caption: Ideal (brick-wall) lowpass filtering at each swept cutoff radius. Radius is in DFT bins; 112 bins = Nyquist along an axis, and 159 covers the corner so the low-pass mask there is the identity. Ringing is the expected Gibbs artefact of a sharp spectral cutoff.

title: Ideal highpass sweep
caption: Ideal (brick-wall) highpass filtering at each swept cutoff radius. Radius is in DFT bins; 112 bins = Nyquist along an axis, and 159 covers the corner so the low-pass mask there is the identity. Ringing is the expected Gibbs artefact of a sharp spectral cutoff.

title: Band-limited noise sweep
caption: Gaussian noise confined to one frequency annulus and rescaled to a fixed spatial RMS of 0.1. Holding energy constant is what makes band index the only variable, so the resulting curve measures model sensitivity rather than how many DFT bins an annulus happens to contain.

title: FFT probe construction
caption: The demo image, its centred log-magnitude spectrum, and three of the binary radial masks the sweep multiplies it by. Low- and high-pass masks at the same radius are exact complements, which the module's self-test asserts (lowpass + highpass reconstructs the original to 4e-07).

title: Nested data fractions
caption: Each smaller fraction is a strict per-class subset of the larger one, so the data-efficiency curve varies only quantity, never composition. Three independent seed nestings give the error bands.
